assets.prompt: Edit this Bureau office game background. Keep the hand-drawn pixel-art treatment, two service desks and broad walkable central floor. Change the floor to pale grey-white square office tiling with subtle grey grout, aligned horizontally and vertically. Replace the ENTIRE back/north wall, edge to edge, with one continuous closed light grey curtain with softly shaded vertical folds: no back windows, no back boards, no paintings on that wall. Move the windows to the FRONT/south side instead, represented visibly in the cutaway foreground wall along the bottom-left and bottom-center. Move the front door from bottom-center to the BOTTOM RIGHT, leaving clear floor access immediately above it. Remove the old center doorway and its plants; the front lower-left/center has windows rather than a doorway. Keep two separated desks along the upper part of the room, left for the boss and right for reception, with clear standing/walking space directly south of each. Keep a filing cabinet by the left wall and a small bench/plant along a side wall, out of the walking lanes. No people or NPCs baked in, no UI, no readable text. Maintain landscape 4:3 and a native design budget of 512x384 pixels, crisp colour clusters, stepped outlines and warm coastal accents on the furniture despite the neutral tiles and curtain. Avoid photographic grain, smooth 3D texture or airbrush gradients. The final image is just the clean playable room background.
